title: Lecturer in the Department of Economics
description:
Lecturer in the Department of Economics

Tenure Status: Non-Tenure Track
Department: Economics - 255150

Minimum Qualifications
A Master's Degree in Economics or a closely related discipline is
required.

Areas of Interest (No Minimum Level Required)
Relevant teaching experience at the university level.

License/Certification Required


Description of the Department or Unit
The Department of Economics is an intellectually vibrant community
that values excellence in both research and teaching, and has
well-established strengths in environmental, resource, experimental
and behavioral economics.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
The Department of Economics at Appalachian State University invites
applications for a full-time, non-tenure-track, 9-month faculty
position for the 2027-28 academic year. The successful candidate
will support teaching in one or more of the following areas:
Principles of Microeconomics, Principles of Macroeconomics, and
Business Statistics. Teaching responsibilities will include courses
offered at the Boone campus, and may include courses at the Hickory
campus and online. In addition to teaching, the faculty member will
contribute to service activities at the department, college, and
university levels.

Proposed Date of Hire: 08/09/2027
Suggested Salary Range: Salary is competitive and
commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Closing Date:
Open Until Filled: Yes
Evaluation of Applications Begins: 12/15/2026

To apply, visit https://appstate.peopleadmin.com/postings/56951
